systems.system: Law enforcement project for criminal justice (strategy to digitise the justice system)
systems.country_label: منظومة إنفاذ القانون / مشروع إنفاذ القانون
systems.owner: Ministries of Justice, Interior and Communications, with the Public Prosecution
systems.tiers: as at August 2020 a strategy still being finalised by the justice and communications ministries: to link police stations electronically to the Public Prosecution and on to the courts of every degree, by developing criminal-justice applications and integrating with the police stations' system, the prosecution's system, the Court of Cassation and the Constitutional Court; the President ordered its steps completed quickly at a meeting two days before publication, at national and governorate level
named only as a system the law enforcement project is to integrate with; what it does and where it runs are not described
named only as a system the law enforcement project is to integrate with; not described

note: Al-Watan, 25 August 2020, on a justice-digitisation strategy in preparation: the police-to-prosecution-to-courts link is an exchange, and the police stations' system is named without any statement of what it does or that stations make a digital record, so no fact for the record class. Its figures are the courts' own (unified litigation programme in more than 129 courts; experts' case-tracking programme in 39 of 45 offices), outside the police field.
